g.text: INTERNSHIP INTERVIEW TECHNICAL PORTFOLIO • END-TO-END WORKFLOW
AI-Based Log Anomaly Detection using DeepLog
Ground Truth by Block ID: Verified using expert-labeled anomaly_label.csv (Severe real-world class imbalance: ~33:1).
EXAMPLE EVENT SEQUENCE PER BLOCK ID:
Bijective dictionary ensures deterministic class indexing across splits.
Initial training set lacked 1 rare event seen
in test data. Sorting keys separately caused
silent index shift (e.g. E5 → ID 3 vs ID 4),
✓ Fixed via Unified Canonical Mapping Dictionary
Execution matches learned pattern (Confidence within Top-K normal candidates).
Unexpected event outside top-ranked candidates (Flagged as sequence defect).
Detection Rule: “Unexpected next-event behavior is flagged as anomaly” (Evaluated at K=5 candidate cutoff).
E5 → E7 is a forbidden transition in normal HDFS execution.
Never occurs in 558K normal blocks; occurs 1,993 times in anomalies!
100% pure anomaly indicator discovered via sequence mining.
“DeepLog learns normal HDFS sequential behavior and detects deviations from learned patterns.”
Zero-labeled anomaly training • Sequence semantics detect stealthy operational defects • Production-ready with 0.3041% FPR.
